sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian number words from nulla to *tíz* are used as basic personal-information building blocks. Learn them as useful forms, not as a grammar system.

Hungarian numbers don’t follow a pattern borrowed from Spanish or Latin, so treat nulla through tíz as ten fresh vocabulary items to drill rather than a system to reason out. Two that trip people up: hat (six) and hét (seven) look and sound almost identical — say them side by side a few times until your ear can tell them apart.
